plugins.name: verified-development
plugins.description: Independent review for work the model does: /review dispatches correctness, test, security and size-gated complexity/a11y agents before any commit; /plan stress-tests a chat plan with three critics; /map writes the repo's test taxonomy. Language-agnostic: runs the repo's own verify command and judges tests against its own test types; Go is the bundled toolchain example; /test-audit spans Go, TypeScript, Python, and Java.
